PRIVACY

Privacy information

Quant$ense is a static educational site. The applets run in your browser and do not require an account or a form submission.

Information in the applets

Slider values and synthetic calculations are processed locally in the page for the current session. The applets do not ask for personal or financial account information.

Contact messages

When you submit the contact form, your name, email address and query are sent to FormSubmit for processing and delivery to vinaydutta27@gmail.com. The owner uses these details to read and respond to your enquiry. Contact messages are retained in the owner’s email inbox; you can request deletion by emailing that address.

FormSubmit provides spam protection and may present a CAPTCHA. Its processing is governed by its privacy policy. Please avoid submitting confidential financial information.

External sources

Some lessons link to Shreve references and the PRA policy statement. Those external sites have their own policies and may record visits according to their terms.

Changes

This page may be updated as the site grows. For questions, use the contact page.
